card.name: Twisting and turning steps for syringes
card.fires_on: Small words like it, a, in, by or and right after a twisting, turning or screwing verb in syringe and needle attachment steps, where a clockwise or counterclockwise direction comes next.

modes.label: Twist/turn instructions
modes.description: Small word after a verb like twisting, turning or screwing, just before the direction of rotation.
modes.example: unscrew the syringe cap by twisting<< it>> counter-clockwise with the other hand.

modes.label: Words in a clockwise phrase
modes.description: Article or preposition inside a phrase leading to clockwise, when attaching a needle to a Luer lock.
modes.example: Screw the needle onto the luer lock end of the syringe in<< a>> clockwise direction until it is firmly attached

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict rotation words such as rotation, rotated and twisting.
card.plain: It fires on the little word after "twist" or "turn" in syringe steps, where the next word describes which way to rotate.
